subject: Renewal + Expansion: multi-year ramp, co-terming, and auto-renew options
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.k@redwood.ai>
To: Tobias Klein <tobias@synapse.ai>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@synapse.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + expansion options — draft term sheet attached

Hi Tobias / Elena,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — great to see Synapse’s usage continuing to scale. Attached is a short draft term sheet with three options we discussed:

- Option A (2yr, phased ramp): 24-month term, staged capacity increase (months 1/6/12/18) with a step-up discount schedule and an onboarding credit.
- Option B (1yr + optional 1yr auto-renew): 12-month base with an opt-in auto-renew that converts to a 2nd year at a pre-agreed uplift; includes co-terming to align billing with Synapse’s fiscal Q1.
- Option C (3yr committed): deeper discount, fixed monthly commit, true-up once annually, preferred capacity reservations during peak windows.

Two practical notes: we can co-term your four existing product lines into a single renewal window (reduce admin friction), and we can front-load a portion of the annual credit to help with the onboarding spike you outlined.

I attached the term sheet and a simple milestone spreadsheet for the ramp. If you prefer, Camila (cc’d) can run through the onboarding/capacity timeline with your ops team next week.

Action: Can you confirm which option you want us to convert into a formal SOW? Also let us know if you need legal language on the auto-renew toggle — we can make that opt-in/out configurable per legal.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.k@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachment: 2026-12-01-Synapse-renewal-term-sheet.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

From: Tobias Klein <tobias@synapse.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.k@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@synapse.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:07:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion options — draft term sheet attached

Markus — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear options. A few quick questions from our side before we pick a path: 

1) For Option A, does the step-up discount apply only once the higher capacity tranche is activated, or retroactively to the start of the term?
2) For Option B, what does the auto-renew uplift look like (percentage) and can we have a 60-day notice window to opt-out?
3) For Option C, we like the reserved capacity idea — can you guarantee priority access during our two forecasted holiday weeks?

Also, procurement asked whether we can co-term with our existing data platform contract — that would make internal billing much easier. PDE (procurement) will also request a SOC 2 addendum; happy to loop legal once we choose the option.

If easier, Elena and I can do a quick call Friday to walk through the numbers.

—Tobias
VP Product, Synapse AI
T: +1 (617) 555-3421

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.b@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion options — draft term sheet attached

Tobias — good questions. Short answers below, then a proposed next step.

1) Option A discount timing: discounts apply from the activation date of each tranche forward (not retroactive). We can add a reconciliation clause on annual true-up if you want partial retroactivity on the first tranche — I’ve included language in redline 2 of the attached term sheet to illustrate.

2) Option B auto-renew uplift: we typically set a 7% uplift for the 2nd-year conversion; we can offer a 4% uplift if you commit to a 60-day opt-out window. We’re flexible on the notice window — proposed default is 30 days but we’ll honor 60 if that’s a hard req.

3) Option C priority access: yes — we can add a reserved capacity SLA for the two named holiday weeks. That becomes a schedule in the SOW with a soft cap on concurrent reserved nodes and an elevated latency SLO.

Co-terming with your data platform contract: fine from our side. We’ll stitch billing to your requested fiscal boundary; that’s what the co-terming line is intended for. Camila can confirm the operational handoffs below.

Proposed next step: pick a preferred option by next Tue (12/8). If you pick A or B I’ll convert the draft into a clean SOW + invoice schedule. If you pick C we’ll prepare the full reserved-capacity appendix and Ops runbook.

I attached a redlined term sheet with the uplift options called out, and a milestone workbook with example ramp dates.

Best,
Markus

Attachment: 2026-12-01-Synapse-renewal-term-sheet.pdf (redline v2)

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Tobias Klein <tobias@synapse.ai>, Elena Park <elena.park@synapse.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.k@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.b@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding & capacity timeline for chosen ramp schedule

Hi Tobias / Elena — Camila here on CS ops. If you go with Option A (phased ramp) or Option B (1yr then convert), here’s a practical onboarding and capacity timeline we recommend: 

- Week 0–2: Kickoff, access, KMS key exchange, SOC 2 addendum intake.
- Week 2–4: Baseline performance tests, tokenization and prompt tuning workshop.
- Month 1: Activate tranche 1 (baseline capacity) + 50% of onboarding credit applied.
- Month 6: Activate tranche 2 (expected 2x baseline) — coordinate a traffic cutover window; runload test 48h prior.
- Month 12: Evaluate performance and, if Option A, activate tranche 3; if Option B and you elect 2nd year, adjust pricing per uplift.

We also recommend a simple spike cap for months 1 and 6 to protect against runaway spend during tuning. I’ve attached an onboarding milestones spreadsheet to show dates relative to signature date. If you confirm a target signature date (T0) I’ll map the calendar weeks for your timezone.

Action for Synapse: confirm preferred option and whether procurement needs a specific invoice cadence (monthly vs quarterly). We’ll prepare the runbook and Ops SLA appendix once we have that.

Thanks — Camila
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: 2026-12-10-onboarding-milestones.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

From: Tobias Klein <tobias@synapse.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.k@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@synapse.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion options — draft term sheet attached

Markus / Camila — thanks for the clarifications and the timeline. We discussed internally and want to proceed with a hybrid approach: base 18-month term (hybrid of A and B) with the following specifics:

- Term: 18 months, co-termed to Synapse fiscal Q1 (starts 2027-02-01).
- Ramp: three tranches at T0, +5 months, +11 months. Discounts apply from activation forward.
- Auto-renew: Opt-out by default; Synapse will only allow auto-renew if we take the 3yr reserved capacity (Option C). So for this deal auto-renew is off.
- Priority windows: include reserved capacity for the two holiday weeks in 2027 with SLA language as discussed.
- Billing: monthly invoices consolidated to a single PO/CDN; procurement prefers net-45.

Procurement will follow up with a short SOC 2 addendum request and our billing contact (Elena) will send PO info. Please convert the hybrid into a clean SOW and draft SOW appendix with the reserved capacity SLA and submit for internal legal review.

Thanks — we’re aligned on timeline and Camila, please map the onboarding calendar against our T0 (2027-02-01).

—Tobias
